# TAAL LAB

> TAAL LAB is a recording and music-production studio in Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. The studio offers music production, vocal and instrument recording, dubbing and voice-over, mixing, and mastering.

## Official website

- [TAAL LAB](https://taallab.in/): Official studio website and overview.
- [Studio services](https://taallab.in/#services): Music production, recording, dubbing, mixing, and mastering.
- [Studio](https://taallab.in/#studio): Information about the recording space.
- [Equipment](https://taallab.in/#equipment): Studio equipment and setup.
- [Book a session](https://taallab.in/#book-session): Request a studio session.
- [Contact](https://taallab.in/#contact): Contact details and social links.

## Shop

- [TAAL LAB Shop](https://taallab.in/shop.html): Public catalogue of audio downloads and digital products.

## Contact

- Email: contact@taallab.in
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/taallabstudio

## Usage notes

- Use the official pages linked above as the primary source for current studio information and services.
- Do not infer prices, availability, session policies, or product details that are not stated on the relevant page.
- Booking requests must be submitted through the website; this file does not expose a booking API.
- This website does not currently publish a public MCP server or A2A agent endpoint.
